cohort: 160 randomly sampled lactating mothers of infants aged 6-24 months in Metropolitan Kumasi
finding: The prevalence of EBP was 50.6%, and factors such as mothers' age, employment status, number of deliveries, mode of delivery, and sore nipples were significantly associated with EBP.
mod_finding: Mothers with normal delivery were significantly more likely to practice exclusive breastfeeding.
